entities.name: Virot Maglan
entities.description: The Cabal Patriarch, leader and founder of Dominaria's Cabal, whose touch decays everything.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A wealthy and influential order on Otaria founded and led by Virot Maglan.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: A god worshipped by the First, who is reborn as Phage's son.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A figure who, even with the Mirari, was unable to kill the First.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: An ambassador who gave Chainer the First's secret name.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful artifact at the center of the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: A battle during which the First was exiled to Aphetto.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: Location to which the First was exiled and from which he regained control of the Cabal.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The land the Cabal grew influential in.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: A coliseum created by the First to extend his influence over Otaria.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: A woman who shares the First's curse of decaying flesh, in whom he found a form of love.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Opponent against whom Phage led the Nightmare War.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: A war led by Phage against Ixidor.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A figure who snapped the First in half with a dementia creature.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Cabal exists.

events.summary: Virot Maglan oversees the Rise of the Cabal and becomes the First, gaining a vastly extended lifespan and a touch that decays anything.
events.quote: Virot Maglan oversaw the Rise of the Cabal and became the First, its Patriarch.

events.summary: During the Battle for the Mirari the First is exiled to Aphetto after Laquatus gives Chainer his secret name.
After Chainer's death the First regains control of the Cabal from Aphetto and plans the Grand Coliseum.
events.quote: the First regained control over the Cabal based in Aphetto

events.summary: The First finds a form of love in Phage and puts her in charge of building the Grand Coliseum.
events.quote: He found a form of love in Phage

events.summary: After sending Phage to lead the Nightmare War, the First receives a vision from Kuberr that they belong together but she might kill him.
events.quote: he received a vision from Kuberr that they belonged together

events.summary: The First tries to assassinate Phage, but her pregnancy stays his hand; her son is the reborn god Kuberr.
events.quote: her revelation that she was pregnant stayed his hand

events.summary: The First, having lost his immortality by betraying Kuberr, tries again to kill Phage but Braids snaps him in half with a dementia creature.
events.quote: allowing Braids to intervene and snap him in half with a dementia creature
